usage: frontier_deploy.py native-localize-images [-h] --config CONFIG
                                                 --document DOCUMENT
                                                 [--candidate CANDIDATE]
                                                 --output OUTPUT (--plan |
                                                 --check | --apply)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG
  --document DOCUMENT
  --candidate CANDIDATE
  --output OUTPUT
  --plan                Offline plan only
  --check               Read-only registry verification
  --apply               Copy exact image manifests; no registration or
                        definition upload
